findings.reading: 412 completers had pre/post literacy or numeracy assessments; 83% completion and 86% attendance are different denominators. Six had numeracy-only and one literacy-only.
2022 intervention compared with 2021 reference group, 6,687 numeracy and 6,413 literacy; not described here as randomised concurrent controls.
Persistent technology disruption associated with lower attendance and progress; intervention provision alone did not remove access barriers.
